title: Iterating the intentionality model yields introspective and social intelligence

statements.text: If a system can point a second-order PMIR at a first-order one, two new forms of intelligence emerge. Introspective intelligence lets it become aware that it has a will, selective attention and, with concepts, a first-person perspective. Social intelligence lets it model other agents as having first-person perspectives, simulate their intentions and mutually acknowledge persons.

sources.quote: two entirely new forms of intelligence emerge
Systems with cognitive PMIRs can mutually acknowledge each other as persons.
